hqDecisions: Technical design reviewed before implementation: separate preflight/main DBs; unchanged formal v8 authority and gameplay algorithms; persistent original legacy baseline prevents silently selecting IDB over later localStorage state.
Detached candidate plus FormalIdbCommitBoundary publishes once after transaction/readback only; sidecar observer state is isolated while pending; all synchronous downstream callbacks converted.
Exact legacy snapshot checks before and after native IDB commits detect old-version writers; cross-store race cannot be atomic, so any uncertainty halts and preserves both sides.
No automatic rollback/retry/reset after corruption or uncertain write; recovery reads are non-mutating. Explicit import/new game preserves displaced valid head permanently.
Every logical tick is saved before publication for safety. Potential 100ms-distillation latency must be measured and reported, not asserted performance-neutral; no catch-up during save.

plan.problem: LocalStorage origin quota stops current real iPhone game near month154; isolated IDB and commit barrier are merged but not connected.
plan.currentContract: Formal v8 reader/serializer validates full game and sidecars; main.v1 synchronous CAS precedes game publication, but scheduler contains transient pre-save mutations and UI consumers assume boolean results.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: IDB is asynchronous and preflight-only. A direct writer replacement would publish state before save and break backup/conflict/clock contracts.
plan.design: Dedicated main database with atomic verified generations and preserved originals; boot/import bridge followed by one fail-stop async commit boundary across every runtime/consumer. Existing formal v8 modules remain sole data authority.
plan.migration: Boot validates and copies exact local main.v1 into empty main IDB only, preserving old keys. External v8 import is user-selected and confirmed; legacy/current displaced bytes are archived. Existing IDB plus changed legacy source stops for explicit resolution, never auto-picks.
plan.compatibility: No native game/economy/RNG/history/recall algorithm or formal v8 format/cap change. Preflight stays separate. Preview remains non-persisting but uses async action result contract.
plan.promotionRisk: Staging-only runtime change. CI alone does not establish browser/iPhone safety or 100-year guarantee. Production forbidden.
